title: Ukraine Strikes Russian Oil
statement: Ukraine hitting Russian oil production threatens their capability to project force in Europe.
evidence_confirmed: Reuters reports June 2026: Russian oil output 10% below target due to strikes
Zelenskyy confirms Syzran and Ufa refinery strikes

Sept 3, 2026 — Putin admits 'We Were Mistaken' (Kyiv Post/Interfax): assumed oil refineries were untargetable civilian facilities. 70+ Ukrainian refinery strikes since Jan 2026; refining output at lowest in 20 years; gasoline covers only ~70% of domestic demand (30k ton/day shortfall); 17 regions rationing fuel; Russia importing gasoline by sea from India/Morocco/Turkey + record Belarus purchases; KINEF (2nd-largest refinery) stopped processing Sept 2.
falsifier: Russian refining/refinery capacity recovers to pre-2026 levels (KINEF restart, gasoline imports fall, rationing ends, output target met) - i.e., the strategic degradation is reversed and Ukraine's campaign stops being force-projection-relevant.
forward_watchlist: KINEF restart date and refining-throughput recovery - the cleanest single recovery signal.
Whether Ukrainian strike tempo sustains (70+ and counting) or Ukraine is coerced/negotiated into a moratorium.
Russian gasoline rationing expansion vs. relaxation across the affected regions.
Sea-borne import dependency (India/Morocco/Turkey/Belarus): sustained = fragility; substituted by domestic = recovery.
Winter immediacy: whether recovered capacity covers heating-season demand without rationing.

title: Assassination as Catalyst (Kirk)
statement: High profile shooting looks staged... just to use as justification for what is coming.
evidence_confirmed: Charlie Kirk shot dead in Utah Sept 10, 2025
NSPM-7 signed shortly after citing domestic terrorism

Sept 1, 2026 (Primary Source / Frontlines TPUSA): Active narrative deployment fusing Charlie Kirk assassination imagery, Portland ICE building protests, and pro-Hamas keffiyeh tropes to brand domestic dissent as violent extremism and prime the base for domestic security crackdowns.
falsifier: No major domestic-security crackdown or base-mobilization action is actually legitimated by the Kirk assassination narrative within 6 months of NSPM-7. The confirmed facts are Kirk was assassinated (verified); the INTERPRETIVE claim that it was staged as justification for what is coming breaks if no appreciable crackdown follows from it.
forward_watchlist: Any substantive domestic enforcement/emergency action explicitly invoking Kirk's assassination as legal or rhetorical justification.
Whether the anniversary memorial (Sept 10) is converted into a mandate for specific policy (ICE surge, domestic-terror reclassification, election-control).
New primary evidence on the shooter: motive, complicity network, or any finding contradicting the lone-wolf framing.
Whether staged is ever corroborated beyond catalytic use - vs. remaining a convenient use of a real tragedy.

title: Fertilizer Supply Crisis
statement: Fertilizer prices are high as supplies are limited.
evidence_confirmed: The Guardian reports 70% price hike for UK farmers
World Bank reports 15% rise in early 2025 continuing into 2026
falsifier: Global fertilizer prices normalize to pre-war levels within the next quarter as alternative supply (US domestic, African, or non-Hormuz routes) closes the gap, OR the Strait reopens restoring Gulf fertilizer export flows, relieving both the price floor and consumer food-price pressure.
forward_watchlist: Monthly fertilizer price indices (World Bank, FAO) - sustained >15-20% YoY elevation or return toward baseline.
Gulf (Qatar/Saudi/UAE) fertilizer export volumes restructuring around Hormuz closure vs. US/domestic capacity absorbing it.
Whether a food-price-shock narrative appears in domestic midterm politics (the regime transmission layer).
Actual landed fertilizer cost at US farm gate - the lagging input that hits food shelves 6-9 months out.
Any fertilizer-specific carve-out corridors in the blockade (humanitarian analog).
